newsitem.title: USA: Amoco seeks to seal Azeri oil contract by Friday.
newsitem.headline: Amoco seeks to seal Azeri oil contract by Friday.

text.p: Amoco Corp officials are trying to settle terms by Friday for an oil development contract with the Azerbaijan state oil company SOCAR, an Amoco spokesman said Thursday.
"We've been having intense discussions in Baku and now in the U.S.," said spokesman David Tayrien. "They are continuing at this moment."
"If we can work out all the details of that agreement, we would be very pleased to sign an agreement with (Azeri) President (Haydar) Aliyev tomorrow," he added.

Tayrien declined to discuss details about the prospect, adding that talks could go on to the last minute before a ceremony here Friday where SOCAR officials plan to sign Caspian oil field contracts with Exxon, Chevron and Mobil.

Exxon Corp's Azerbaijan affiliate intends to seal a contract for the Nakhchivan field. Chevron Corp's overseas unit hopes to sign a contract for the Absheron field, formerly called Tagiev, a Chevron spokeswoman said.
SOCAR officials earlier said the Mobil contract would involve the D-30 and Oguz fields.
